item.phoneHint: Who you call about this moment.

deliveries.title: Deliveries today
deliveries.none: No delivery scheduled for this day.

form.conditionsHint: Required for “Proceed with conditions”: what has to hold.
form.evidenceHint: Tick at least one piece of evidence: a task, a delivery, an acknowledged briefing — or write a note with a link.

errors.time: Write the time in the format 18:30.
errors.phone: Write a valid phone number, for example 0722 123 456.
errors.titleRequired: Write what happens at this moment.
errors.evidenceRequired: Add at least one piece of evidence: tick a task, a delivery or an acknowledged briefing, or write a note with a link.
errors.evidenceMissing: One of the chosen pieces of evidence no longer exists. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.evidenceTooMany: You chose too many pieces of evidence. Keep the most important ones.
errors.conditionsRequired: Write the conditions under which we proceed.
errors.noteUrl: Write a full link that starts with https://.
